$ cat rollout.json
{"plans": {"api": {"description": "The API."}, "web": {"description": "The website."}}}
$ rollout apply web --region us-east
apply web in us-east
[exit 0]

$ cat rollout.json
{"plans": {"api": {"description": "The API."}, "web": {"description": "The website."}}}
$ rollout apply nope
rollout: main: unknown plan: nope
[exit 1]

# The commands for the first word.
$ rollout completion zsh -- ''
apply	Apply a plan.
logs	Write the log files of the plans.
completion	Write the completion script of a shell.
:values
[exit 0]

# The plans of rollout.json, from the function of App.Complete.
$ cat rollout.json
{"plans": {"api": {"description": "The API."}, "web": {"description": "The website."}}}
$ rollout completion zsh -- apply ''
api	The API.
web	The website.
:values
[exit 0]

# The plans of the config file of the words.
$ cat other.json
{"plans": {"db": {"description": "The database."}}}
$ rollout completion zsh -- -c other.json apply ''
db	The database.
:values
[exit 0]

$ rollout completion zsh -- apply web --region ''
eu-west
us-east
:values
[exit 0]

# A value after the equals sign of its flag.
$ rollout completion zsh -- apply web --region=u
--region=us-east
:values
[exit 0]

# bash receives the commands without their help texts.
$ rollout completion bash -- ''
apply
logs
completion
:values
[exit 0]

# The shell offers the files of the formats for a config file.
$ rollout completion zsh -- -c ''
:files ini json
[exit 0]

$ rollout completion zsh -- logs ''
:files
[exit 0]
